paite: Aw, TOUPA pahtawi in la thak sa un; thillamdangtakte ahihta ngal a! Akhut taklam leh aban siangthou in amah a ding in hotdamna ahihsakta hi.
heading: Phatna La / Pathian, Khovel Vaihawmpa
english: A Psalm. Sing to Yahweh a new song, for he has done marvelous things! His right hand and his holy arm have worked salvation for him.

paite: TOUPA'N ahotdamna atheisak a, adiktatna namte mitmuh in chiantak in alangsakta hi.
english: Yahweh has made known his salvation. He has openly shown his righteousness in the sight of the nations.

paite: Israel inkuanpihte tung a azahngaihna leh aginomdan atheigige a; kawlmong a mi tengteng in, Pathian hotdamna amuta uhi.
english: He has remembered his loving kindness and his faithfulness toward the house of Israel. All the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God.

paite: Leitung luah tengteng aw, TOUPA pahtawi in nuamsatak in kikou unla; kikoukhia unla nuamsa in la sa un, ahi, phatna la sa un.
english: Make a joyful noise to Yahweh, all the earth! Burst out and sing for joy, yes, sing praises!

paite: Kaihging toh TOUPA phat in la sa un, kaihging leh phatna la husa toh.
english: Sing praises to Yahweh with the harp, with the harp and the voice of melody.

paite: Pengkulte leh pengkul binei ging toh kumpipa, TOUPA ma ah, nuamsatak in kikou un.
english: With trumpets and sound of the ram’s horn, make a joyful noise before the King, Yahweh.

paite: Tuipi leh asung a thil om tengteng lum honhon hen; khovel leh asung a tengteng toh,
english: Let the sea roar with its fullness; the world, and those who dwell therein.

paite: luipite'n akhut uh beng uhenla; mualte'n nuam in la sakhawm uhen,
english: Let the rivers clap their hands. Let the mountains sing for joy together.

paite: TOUPA ma ah; lei vaihawm ding in, ahong pai dek ngal a khovel diktattak in vai ahawmsak ding a, khentuam nei lou in michih vai ahawmsak ding hi.
english: Let them sing before Yahweh, for he comes to judge the earth. He will judge the world with righteousness, and the peoples with equity.
